evidence: Read-only discovery (enclave arm) and a DOM read on 2026-09-21 of auth0.auth0.com/u/signup/identifier, then a REAL signup on 2026-09-28 through the proxy, from manage.auth0.com via the login page's 'Sign up' link: email, an emailed code, then a password, all accepted. Claims Auth0's own tenant and dashboard entry point only; auth0.com itself is deliberately not claimed, because a claim covers subdomains and every customer tenant is a subdomain of it.
gotchas: auth0.com/signup is NOT this form: it is a separate Okta-branded page that none of the auth0 platform selectors match. Start at manage.auth0.com instead.
manage.auth0.com ignores screen_hint=signup and opens the LOGIN form (the mode_toggle precondition). Click its 'Sign up' link to reach /u/signup/identifier.
On this tenant the email is verified with an emailed code BEFORE the password is asked for. That code is the account owner's: hand off with request_challenge_handoff.
